note.en: Finite-grid numerical reference The system is xprime = v and vprime = mu(1 - x squared)v - x, initially (2, 0), over T = 2. The first error, 4.535633779e-5, exceeded the original 2e-5 goal. Local tolerances do not guarantee global accuracy, and reporting PASS does not mean all original goals were met. Full large-mu cycles are outside scope.
